contributorRoles.description: Role labels accepted for contributor rows.
contributorRoles.title: Contributor Roles

cookieString.description: Optional browser-exported name=value; name2=value2 header. Parsed locally into authorized session cookies; the raw header is never emitted or logged.
cookieString.title: Optional Cookie Header String

feedTab.description: Requested tab; only exact visible labels are selected, and unavailable tabs produce no feed rows.
feedTab.title: Requested Feed Tab

includeContributors.description: Emit only contributors found inside explicitly labeled role regions.
includeContributors.title: Include Contributors

includeFeed.description: Emit bounded visible feed item rows.
includeFeed.title: Include Feed

includeFieldEvidence.description: Retain field_sources and fields_present after projection; disabling removes only these evidence maps.
includeFieldEvidence.title: Include Field Evidence

includeMedia.description: Include visible media URLs when present.
includeMedia.title: Include Media

includeMetadata.description: Emit one Space metadata row per successfully observed Space.
includeMetadata.title: Include Metadata

includeOutboundLinks.description: Include bounded outbound links from feed cards.
includeOutboundLinks.title: Include Outbound Links

includeRules.description: Include explicitly headed rules or guidelines text.
includeRules.title: Include Rules

includeSettings.description: Opt in to explicitly labeled public/authorized Space settings and content-permission evidence; missing settings remain not_observed and admin-only submission queues are never scraped.
includeSettings.title: Include Explicit Space Settings

includeUnchanged.description: Legacy compatibility: when explicitly true, keeps unchanged rows even while onlyNewItems is enabled. When omitted or false, onlyNewItems suppresses unchanged rows.
includeUnchanged.title: Include Unchanged

language.description: Browser language hint. Short language codes and supported regional aliases are accepted and normalize to the short code; auto keeps the actor default. This does not translate content or prove access.
language.title: Browser Language

maxConcurrency.description: Bounded number of source pages processed concurrently.
maxConcurrency.title: Maximum Concurrency

maxDiscoveryResults.description: Maximum Space links emitted by each query discovery row.
maxDiscoveryResults.title: Maximum Discovered Spaces

maxFeedQuestionExpansions.description: When Scrape Depth is detail, bounded number of question-type feed items to open and expand into full question fields (question_id, question_answer_count, question_view_count, question_details, question_created_at, question_updated_at). Zero keeps the feed-digest-only behavior.
maxFeedQuestionExpansions.title: Maximum Feed Question Expansions

maxItems.description: Global output row cap; zero means no explicit cap.
maxItems.title: Maximum Output Rows

maxItemsPerSource.description: Maximum semantic records emitted from each direct URL, query, or typed source. Status and run-manifest rows are preserved. Use 0 for no per-source cap.
maxItemsPerSource.title: Maximum Items Per Source

maxLoadMoreAttempts.description: Bounded attempts to activate visible feed load-more controls; click and termination state are reported.
maxLoadMoreAttempts.title: Maximum Load More Attempts

maxNavigationRetries.description: Bounded retries for transient navigation failures; retry counts and delays are reported.
maxNavigationRetries.title: Maximum Navigation Retries

maxScrollAttempts.description: Bounded scroll budget for visible feed traversal; termination state is reported per run.
maxScrollAttempts.title: Maximum Scroll Attempts

onlyNewItems.description: Suppress unchanged rows when configured with a state store. Explicitly set includeUnchanged to true only if you also want unchanged rows.
onlyNewItems.title: Only New Items

outputFields.description: Optional allowlist for compact rows, including bounded dotted paths through nested collections (for example answers.answer_text, comments.comment_text, feed.feed_text, or contributors.contributor_name where applicable). Child identity/URL fields and the actor identity, access/status, source, traversal, graph, filter, and parser-envelope fields remain protected.
outputFields.title: Output Fields (Optional)

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Apify's free AUTO pool is used automatically; no proxy setup is required. Any group you explicitly choose is preserved, but the actor never forces RESIDENTIAL. Missing proxy credentials fall back to a direct connection.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

requestDelay.description: Delay between source pages in seconds.
requestDelay.title: Request Delay

scrapeDepth.description: Overview captures metadata/status only and disables feed, contributor, scroll, and load-more work. Detail preserves bounded monitoring traversal; it is not complete history.
scrapeDepth.title: Scrape Depth

searchQueries.description: Native Quora search queries used for bounded Space-link and entity-link discovery evidence.
searchQueries.title: Discovery Queries

spaceUrls.description: Direct /q/ Space routes or Space subdomain URLs.
spaceUrls.title: Space URLs

startUrls.description: API-compatible request objects for any public Quora URL (Space, question, answer, profile, topic, or post); auto-routed by URL shape the same way as spaceUrls/urls.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

stateRetentionDays.description: Opt-in age-based pruning for unseen state snapshots; zero disables pruning.
stateRetentionDays.title: State Retention Days

stateStoreId.description: Key-value store used for bounded feed/Space/generic-URL snapshots and change evidence. Required when onlyNewItems is enabled, and required whenever urls (entity-agnostic monitoring) is populated.
stateStoreId.title: State Store ID

urls.description: Any public Quora URL (question, answer, profile, topic, or standalone post) to monitor for content-level changes (title/body changed) between runs. Space URLs are automatically routed to the richer Space-aware path below; every other Quora URL is monitored via the generic title/content-hash change mechanism. Requires stateStoreId.
urls.title: Any Quora URLs (Entity-Agnostic Monitoring)
